answer: Part 5.2 requires identifying and inventorying all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s). The operator's document CIP Cyber Security Policy — 3.4.5 System Access Controls Process (R5) shows this is done: "Identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s) (Part 5.2)".
